## Summary
Mohammed Sarfaraz Uddin Nasser (Sarfaraz) is an ambitious Frontend Developer and 3rd-year Computer Science Engineering student at ISL Engineering College (2024–2028) based in Hyderabad, India. He specializes in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. He has shipped real-world client-facing websites and won 2nd Place (₹10,000 cash prize) at the national-level Hack4SDG hackathon organized by AIESEC and IIT Hyderabad.
